title: Cyberdeck MCP configuration
description: Policy for the cyberdeck MCP server: roles, models, Pi tool allowlists, roots, and limits.

provider.description: Pi provider name. Only openrouter is supported.

workspaceRoots.description: Directories that working_directory and context_files must resolve inside. Root and home are refused.

items.description: Absolute path, config-relative path, or @cwd (the MCP server process's working directory).

artifactDirectory.description: Where per-run artifact directories are created (absolute or config-relative).

command.description: Executable to run (default: pi on PATH).

arguments.description: Arguments placed before cyberdeck's own Pi flags.

stateDirectory.description: PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR for isolated Pi auth/settings, or null to reuse the user's Pi state.

trustProjectFiles.description: true passes --approve (trust project-local Pi extensions); false passes --no-approve.

loadContextFiles.description: false passes --no-context-files so Pi ignores AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md.

profiles.description: The two permission profiles behind the research and implement tools.

research.description: Read-only profile; its tools may not include bash, edit, or write.

role.description: A preset agent the caller selects by name.

model.description: OpenRouter model ID; must match the profile's modelPatterns.

when.description: One line the calling agent sees: when to pick this role.

defaultThinking.description: Used when the caller omits thinking. Defaults to the profile value.

maxThinking.description: Ceiling for this role; may not exceed the profile's maxThinking.

promptPreamble.description: Overrides the profile promptPreamble for this role.

modelPatterns.description: Allowlist for role models and caller model overrides; * is a wildcard.

defaultRole.description: Role used when the caller omits role.

defaultThinking.description: Fallback defaultThinking for roles that do not set one.

maxThinking.description: Ceiling for every role in this profile.

tools.description: Exact Pi built-in or extension tool names passed as --tools.

promptPreamble.description: Appended to Pi's system prompt for every role unless the role overrides it.

roles.description: Named roles; keys are lowercase identifiers.

limits.description: Server-side ceilings; the MCP input schema mirrors the caller-facing ones.

maxConcurrentRuns.description: Pi runs allowed at once; further calls are rejected, not queued.

defaultTimeoutSeconds.description: Wall-clock limit when the caller omits timeout_seconds.

defaultReturnCharacters.description: final_output cap when the caller omits return_characters.

maxArtifactBytes.description: Combined stdout+stderr bytes captured per run; Pi is stopped beyond this.
